title: Hearty Roasted Indian Lentil Dal
description: A comforting and nostalgic Indian dish featuring roasted lentils and a hint of demerara sugar, this dal is a perfect blend of flavors and textures. It is also ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, blanch the red lentils in boiling water for 10 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onion, garlic, and ginger until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato, garam masala, turmeric, and salt to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked lentils, sugar, and the pan mixture, and stir well.
Add the water to the baking dish and bring to a boil.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the dal in the oven for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
